# ANALYSIS: WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE_EXTENDED_STUDY

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The edge-per-trade of the vwap_continuation signal (ITM-2, -8%/+30%) increases monotonically with DTE from 0 to 2 days ($36.34 → $59.02 → $66.13). We hypothesize that this trend may continue or plateau at 3 and 4 DTE, and we aim to identify the DTE that maximizes edge-per-trade for this signal.

## Mechanism

Same as the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate: trigger is the vwap_continuation signal (first qualifying morning bar ≤10:30 ET that continues in-trend), entry at next bar open, ITM-2 strike, same exit logic (-8% stop / +30% target) applied at the end of the DTE holding period or upon stop/target hit, whichever occurs first. We extend the holding period to 3 and 4 DTE using the upcoming OPRA backfill (options_3dte/4dte) to compute OOS expectancy per trade.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (same as WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE).
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size per DTE bucket ≈ OOS window length minus DTE (negligible difference over 16 months); selection: all vwap_continuation signals in OOS window; overfit risk low as we are only varying DTE without parameter optimization.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (awaiting options_3dte/4dte backfill to compute OOS exp/tr for 3 and 4 DTE).
